description: This file defines models and fetcher logic for OECD Real GDP data, including query parameter validation, data transformation, and data fetching from OECD API.

classes.name: OECDGdpRealQueryParams
classes.description: Model for OECD Real GDP query parameters, including country selection and frequency.

classes.name: OECDGdpRealData
classes.description: Data model for OECD Real GDP data.

classes.name: OECDGdpRealFetcher
classes.description: Fetcher class for retrieving OECD Real GDP data, including query transformation and data extraction.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Transforms input parameters into a validated OECDGdpRealQueryParams object, setting default start and end dates.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches and processes OECD GDP data from the OECD API endpoint.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Converts raw data into OECDGdpRealData model instances.
